method: Independent exact arithmetic and explicit derivation, separate from animation code
general_argument: For finite real scores, exp(x_i+c)=exp(c)exp(x_i); the positive common factor cancels from numerator and denominator. Taking c=-max(x) bounds each exponential by1 and leaves at least one equal to1.
limits: Finite-precision tiny terms may underflow; normalized scores alone do not prove calibrated model probabilities.
